title: 3dGrayplot
description: Make a grayplot from a 3D+time dataset, like a carpet plot. Result is saved to a PNG image.

mask.description: Name of mask dataset. Voxels that are 0 in the mask will not be processed.
mask.title: Mask dataset

prefix.description: Name for the output file. Default is Grayplot.png
prefix.title: Output file

dimensions.description: Output size of image in pixels: [width height]. Defaults are width=1024 and height=512.
dimensions.title: Output dimensions

resample_old.description: Original resampling method for processed dataset.
resample_old.title: Old resampling method

polort.description: Order of polynomials for detrending. Default is 2. Use '-1' if data is already detrended and de-meaned.
polort.title: Polynomial order

fwhm.description: FWHM of blurring radius to use in the dataset before making the image. Default is 0 mm.
fwhm.title: Blurring FWHM

pvorder.description: Order the voxels by how well they match the two leading principal components of their partition.
pvorder.title: PV order

LJorder.description: Order the voxels by their Ljung-Box statistics, a measure of temporal correlation.
LJorder.title: LJ order

peelorder.description: Order the voxels by how many 'peel' steps are needed to get from the partition boundary to the voxel.
peelorder.title: Peel order

ijkorder.description: Default intra-partition ordering by dataset 3D index ('ijk').
ijkorder.title: IJK order

range.description: Set the range of the data to be plotted. Value of 0 is middle-gray, +X is white, -X is black.
range.title: Data range

percent.description: Scale values to percent differences from the mean of each voxel timeseries. Suitable for raw time series datasets.
percent.title: Percent scaling

raw_with_bounds.description: Map values <= A to black, values >= B to white, and intermediate values to grays.
raw_with_bounds.title: Raw with bounds
